measurements.rtt_jitter_loss: 100 ICMP probes at 20 ms spacing; RTT mean and population stddev
measurements.utilization: measured source veth TX bytes / actual elapsed interval / capacity; not VPP
measurements.raw_counter_audit: per-frame TX counter before/after, elapsed seconds and configured Mbps

collection.split_rule: whole chronological episodes; all WANs together; no cross-episode windows
collection.acceptance: at least 2% MAE gain, >=3 episode groups, >=30 windows, paired episode-block 95% CI upper<0
collection.loss_definition: NetEm loss probability on each direction; target is measured round-trip ICMP loss, not configured probability.
collection.model_changes: loss head only; keep RTT, jitter, utilization weights of frozen v2 unchanged
collection.search: existing predeclared 5 Ridge alphas and 4 XGBoost configurations; residual weights 0/.25/.5/.75/1; Tune only
collection.coverage: Report nonzero targets, MAE on all/zero/nonzero targets and every episode; never choose windows based on prediction error.
collection.holdout_policy: One evaluation after freezing selection/gate; no retraining after viewing holdout.

candidate_selection.linear_features: current level plus relative lag1/lag3/mean, stddev, observed slope*30; training-only standardization
candidate_selection.selection: minimum tuning MAE only; ties prefer smaller weight then linear before trees in declared order
candidate_selection.acceptance: untouched chronological acceptance; >=2% MAE reduction, >=3 episode groups, >=30 samples, paired episode-block bootstrap 95% CI upper<0
candidate_selection.rejection: use persistence; do not try another candidate on acceptance
candidate_selection.holdout: report only after selection and acceptance are frozen; no retuning
